notes: Base rate and the match_second / abs_score_diff / goals_so_far / red-card terms are fitted by Poisson regression on 3282 historical matches, validated on a held-out most-recent season per league. The activityCoefficients are NOT fitted: SportMonks stores shots, corners and attacks as cumulative fixture statistics rather than timestamped events, so no point-in-time value is recoverable from history. They are applied relative to activityCenters so ordinary activity leaves the fitted intensity unchanged. xG is unavailable on this plan and stays at zero.
